How to play Word Swap

Swap two words. Watch sentences break. Pick two random words — say 'banana' and 'Monday'. For the next 5 minutes, every time you'd say one, you must say the other. Normal conversation becomes surreal fast.

2–8 players~8 minSilly & ConfusingWord games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Group picks two common words to swap (e.g., 'water' and 'chair').
  2. For the next round, those words are permanently swapped in conversation.
  3. Play continues normally — chat, answer questions, tell a story.
  4. Anyone who uses the original word instead of the swap loses a point.
  5. After 5 minutes, pick new swap words.

Example round

  • Swap: 'cat' ↔ 'phone'. 'Can you pass me my cat?' 'The cat keeps meowing.' 'My phone scratched me.'
  • Swap: 'yes' ↔ 'no'. 'Do you like pizza?' 'No!' (meaning yes). Instant chaos.

Tips

  • Swap a word with its opposite for maximum brain short-circuit.
  • Best swap combos: a noun + a verb ('run' ↔ 'pizza').
